AssessmentAcademicSubject.description: The description of the academic content or subject area (e.g., arts, mathematics, reading, or a foreign language) being evaluated.

AssessmentIdentifier.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity. This may be the publisher identifier.

AssessmentLevelForWhichDesigned.description: The typical grade or combination of grade-levels, developmental leves, or age-levels for which an assessment is designed

AssessmentObjective.description: This is the objective that the assessment is measuring

AssessmentProvider.description: Identifies the provider or publisher of the assessment.

AssessmentPurpose.description: The reason for which an assessment is designed or delivered

AssessmentRevisionDate.description: The month, day, and year that the conceptual design for the assessment was most recently revised substantially

AssessmentScoreMetricType.description: The specific method used to report the performance and achievement of the assessment. This is the metric that is being used to derive the scores.

AssessmentShortName.description: An abbreviated title for an assessment.

AssessmentTitle.description: The title name or name of the assessment

AssessmentType.description: The category of an assessment based on format and content.

ContentStandard.description: An indication as to whether an assessment conforms to a standard (e.g., local standard, statewide standard, regional standard, association standard).

AssessmentLanguage.description: The language in which the assessment form is designed to be delivered

ActualEndDateTime.description: Date and time the assessment actually ended.

ActualStartDateTime.description: Date and time the assessment actually began.

AssessmentSessionLocation.description: The description of the place where an assessment is administered.

DeliveryDeviceDetails.description: The details about the device or platform by with which the assessment was delivered to the learner.

TimeAssessed.description: The overall time a learner actually spent during the assessment session.

AssessmentPerformanceLevelDescriptiveFee.description: A feedback message designed to be reported with the assessment performance level.

AssessmentPerformanceLevelIdentifier.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment performance level.

AssessmentPerformanceLevelLabel.description: A label representing the performance level appropriate for use on a report.

AssessmentPerformanceLevelLowerCutScore.description: Lowest possible score for the performance level.

AssessmentPerformanceLevelUpperCutScore.description: Highest possible score for the performance level.

CompletionStatus.description: The completion and scoring status for an instance of a person taking an assessment.

ReasonNotCompleting.description: The primary reason a participant did not complete an assessment.

ResultDataType.description: The data type of the assessment result score value.

ScoreType.description: Indicates the purpose for which this assessment score instance was recorded.

ScoreValue.description: A meaningful raw score, derived score, or statistical expression of the performance of a person on an assessment. The type of result is indicated by the Assessment Score Metric Type element. The results can be expressed as a number, percentile, range, level, etc. The score relates to all scored items or a sub test scoring one aspect of performance on the test. This value may or may not correspond to one or more Performance Levels.

lastChangeDateTime.description: A system generated timestamp of the most recent change to this record. This conforms to ISO 8601 dateTime definition [ISO 8601].

officialSourceURL.description: The URL link to the formal citation of the original achievement standards document created for humans.

subjectURI.description: A set of Link URIs denoting the set of subjects for the document as designated by the promulgating agency.

CompetencyAssociationConnectionCitation.description: Any citation appropriate to evidence the connection between nodes.

CompetencyAssociationDestinationNodeName.description: Name of the destination node when the Competency Association is used as a connector in a learning map.

CompetencyAssociationDestinationNodeURI.description: URI of the destination node when the Competency Association is used as a connector in a learning map.

CompetencyAssociationIdentifierURI.description: A URI that establishes uniqueness of an association between a competency definition and another competency item or other objects such as learning resources.

CompetencyAssociationOriginNodeName.description: Name of the origin node when the Competency Association is used as a connector in a learning map.

CompetencyAssociationOriginNodeURI.description: URI of the origin node when the Competency Association is used as a connector in a learning map.

CompetencyAssociationType.description: Defines the nature of the association between a Competency Definition and an associated data object such as a Learning Resource, an Assessment Item, or even another Competency Definition.

CompetencyAssociationWeight.description: Indicates the relative significance this connection has for the destination node in a learning map.

CompetencyDefinitionCode.description: A human-referenceable code designated by the publisher to identify the item in the hierarchy of competency definitions.

CompetencyDefinitionConceptKeyword.description: The significant topicality of the competency definition using free-text keywords and phrases.

CompetencyDefinitionCurrentVersionIndica.description: Indicates that this is the most current version of the Competency Definition.

CompetencyDefinitionEducationLevel.description: The education level, grade level or primary instructional level at which a Competency Definition is intended.

CompetencyDefinitionLanguage.description: The default language of the text used for the content in the competency definition statement.

CompetencyDefinitionLicense.description: The full text or URL reference to a legal document giving official permission to do something with the competency definition statement.

CompetencyDefinitionNodeAccessibilityPro.description: When the Competency Definition is used as a node in a learning map, this element supports alternative pathways based on a learner's accessibility profile. The type selected indicates which accessibility profile the node is designed to address.

CompetencyDefinitionNodeName.description: The name or label displayed on the node when this competency definition is used in learning.

CompetencyDefinitionRightsHolder.description: The person or organization owning or managing rights over the competency framework.

CompetencyDefinitionSequence.description: A set of one or more alphanumeric characters and/or symbols denoting the positioning of the statement being described in a sequential listing of statements.

CompetencyDefinitionStatement.description: The text of the statement. The textual content that either describes a specific competency or describes a less granular group of competencies within the taxonomy of the competency framework.

CompetencyDefinitionTestabilityType.description: Indicates if the competency described in the Competency Definition Statement can be tested using one or more assessment items.

CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexityMaximu.description: The maximum value in the range of text complexity applicable to a language competency definition using the scaling system defined by Text Complexity System, e.g. Lexile(tm).

CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexityMinimu.description: The minimum value in the range of text complexity applicable to a language competency definition using the scaling system defined by Text Complexity System, e.g. Lexile(tm).

CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexitySystem.description: The scaling system used to specify the text complexity of a competency item.

CompetencyDefinitionTypeURL.description: The class of statement in the structure of statements in the Competency Framework according to a controlled vocabulary, specified as a URI referencing a controlled vocabulary.

CompetencyDefinitionTypicalAgRangeMaximu.description: The typical maximum age at which a person learns the defined competency.

CompetencyDefinitionTypicalAgeRangeMinim.description: The typical minimum age at which a person learns the defined competency.

CompetencyDefinitionURI.description: A network-resolvable Uniform Resource Locator (URL) pointing to the authoritative reference for the competency definition.

CompetencyDefinitionValidEndDate.description: The year, month and day the competency definition was deprecated/replaced by the jurisdiction in which it was intended to apply.

CompetencyDefinitionValidStartDate.description: The year, month and day the competency definition was adopted by the jurisdiction in which it was intended to apply.

CompetencyDefinitionVersion.description: A label assigned by the publisher indicating the version of the competency framework statement.

CompetencyFrameworkCreator.description: The person or organization chiefly responsible for the intellectual content of the competency framework.

CompetencyFrameworkDescription.description: A textual description of the scope and contents of the competency framework.

CompetencyFrameworkIdentifierURI.description: An unambiguous reference to the competency framework using a network-resolvable URI.

CompetencyFrameworkJurisdiction.description: A legal, quasi-legal, organizational or institutional domain of the entity mandating the use of the statement--e.g., California.

CompetencyFrameworkLanguage.description: The default language of the text used for the content in the competency framework.

CompetencyFrameworkLicense.description: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the competency framework.

CompetencyFrameworkPublicationDate.description: The date on which this content was first published.

CompetencyFrameworkPublicationStatus.description: The publication status of the competency framework is "Published".

CompetencyFrameworkPublisher.description: The entity responsible for making the competency framework available.

CompetencyFrameworkRights.description: The information about rights held in and over the resource.

CompetencyFrameworkSubject.description: The topic or academic subject of the competency framework.

CompetencyFrameworkTitle.description: The name of the competency framework.

CompetencyFrameworkValidEndDate.description: The year, month and day the competency framework was deprecated/replaced by the jurisdiction in which it was intended to apply.

CompetencyFrameworkValidStartDate.description: The year, month and day the competency framework was adopted by the jurisdiction in which it was intended to apply.

CompetencyFrameworkVersion.description: Defines the revision of the competency framework as a version number or date.

abbreviatedStatement.description: An abbreviated version of the Full Statement.

altCodedNotation.description: An alphanumeric notation or ID code identifying this competency in common use among end-users.

ceterms-environmentalHazardType.description: Type of condition in the physical work performance environment that entails risk exposures requiring mitigating processes; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms-physicalCapabilityType.description: Type of physical activity required or expected in performance; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ceterms-sensoryCapabilityType.description: Type of required or expected sensory capability; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

hasProgressionLevel.description: Reference to a specific point in a progression model.

CourseBeginDate.description: The year, month and day an instance of a course officially began.

CourseCodeSystem.description: A system that is used to identify the organization of subject matter and related learning experiences provided for the instruction of students.

CourseDescription.description: A description of the course content and/or goals. Reference may be made to state or national content standards.

CourseEndDate.description: The year, month and day an instance of a course ends.

CourseIdentifier.description: The actual code that identifies the organization of subject matter and related learning experiences provided for the instruction of students.

CourseSubjectAbbreviation.description: The alphabetic abbreviation of the academic department or discipline offering the course. It is one part of the total course identifier number.

CourseTitle.description: The descriptive name given to a course of study offered in a school or other institution or organization. In departmentalized classes at the elementary, secondary, and postsecondary levels (and for staff development activities), this refers to the name by which a course is identified (e.g., American History, English III). For elementary and other non-departmentalized classes, it refers to any portion of the instruction for which a grade or report is assigned (e.g., reading, composition, spelling, and language arts).

CreditValue.description: The amount of credit available to the student who successfully meets the objectives of the course or learning opportunity based on the units defined by Credit Unit Type.

RelatedCompetencyDefinitions.description: An indication of the competency definition(s) addressed in the Course Section.

CourseAcademicGradeScaleCode.description: The grading scale used by an academic educational institution for an academic course.

CourseAlignedWithStandards.description: An indication whether a course is aligned with the established standards of a curriculum framework.

CourseSectionTimeRequiredForCompletion.description: The actual or estimated number of clock minutes required for course completion. This number is especially important for career and technical education course and may represent (in minutes) the clock hour requirement of the course, the number of minutes (or clock hours) of class time per week, times the number of equivalent weeks the class typically meets.

CourseAcademicGrade.description: The final grade awarded for participation in the course.

CourseAddDate.description: The date an individual was added to an academic course at a school.

CourseDropDate.description: The date on which the individual drops or withdraws from the course.

CourseOverrideSchool.description: The school where the credit was earned if different from the institution reporting.

CourseSectionEnrollmentStatusEndDate.description: The date on which the enrollment status ended related to a student enrolled in an instance of a course.

CourseSectionEnrollmentStatusStartDate.description: The date on which the enrollment status began related to a student enrolled in an instance of a course.

CTDLAudienceLevelType.description: Type of level indicating a point in a progression through an educational or training context, for which the credential is intended; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

ClassificationOfInstructionalProgramCode.description: A six-digit code in the form xx.xxxx that identifies instructional program specialties within educational institutions.

CompetencyDefinitionURL.description: A network-resolvable Uniform Resource Locator (URL) pointing to the authoritative reference for the competency definition.

CredentialDefinitionAlternateName.description: An alias for the credential, which may include acronyms, alphanumeric notations, and other forms of name abbreviations in common use such as PhD, MA, and BA.

CredentialDefinitionAssessmentMethodType.description: The method used to conduct the assessment being referenced.

CredentialDefinitionCategoryType.description: A category for defining a competency or qualification, achievement, personal or organizational quality, experience, attribute, or aspect of an identity typically used to indicate suitability.

CredentialDefinitionCriteria.description: The criteria for competency-based completion of the achievement/award.

CredentialDefinitionCriteriaURL.description: The Uniform Resource Locator (URL) for the unique address of a web page describing the competency-based completion criteria for the achievement/award.

CredentialDefinitionDateEffective.description: Effective date of the content of a credential definition.

CredentialDefinitionEstimatedDuration.description: The estimated amount of time in minutes it will take to earn the credential.

CredentialDefinitionIdentifier.description: A globally unique identifier by which the creator/owner/provider of a credential recognizes the achievement in transactions with the external environment.

CredentialDefinitionIdentifierSystem.description: A coding scheme that is used for identification and record-keeping purposes by a credentialing organization to refer to an achievement.

CredentialDefinitionKeywords.description: Keywords or key phrases describing aspects of a credential considered useful for its discovery.

CredentialDefinitionMaximumDuration.description: The maximum amount of time in minutes it will take to earn the described credential.

CredentialDefinitionMinimumAge.description: The minimum allowed age in years at which a person is eligible for the credential.

CredentialDefinitionMinimumDuration.description: The minimum amount of time in minutes it will take to earn the described credential.

CredentialDefinitionNAICSIndustryType.description: The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) class identifier for an industry associated with the credential.

CredentialDefinitionStatusType.description: The status of the credential offered by a credentialing organization.

CredentialDefinitionTitle.description: The title assigned to the achievement.

CredentialImageURL.description: The Uniform Resource Locator (URL) for the unique address of an image representing an award or badge associated with the achievement.

O*NET-SOCOccupationType.description: The O*NET-SOC taxonomy defines the set of occupations across the world of work based on the Standard Occupational Classification.

subject.description: Words or brief phrases describing the topicality of the entity; select subject terms from an existing enumeration of such terms.

CTID.description: Globally unique Credential Transparency Identifier (CTID) by which the creator, owner or provider of a resource recognizes it in transactions with the external environment (e.g., in verifiable claims involving the resource).

accreditedBy.description: Quality assurance organization that provides official authorization to, or approval of, a credential, organization, assessment, or learning opportunity.

accreditedIn.description: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which the credential, learning opportunity or assessment is accredited.

CourseQualityPointsEarned.description: The numerical value assigned to a letter grade to provide a basis of quantitative determination of an average.

StudentIdentifier.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a student by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity.

expirationDate.description: The date when the credential expires. This property is inherited from Verifiable Credential.

issuanceDate.description: Defines the date and time, when the European Digital Credential becomes valid. This property is inherited from Verifiable Credential.

owner.description: The person (subject) about which claims are made and who owns the credential. This property is inherited from Verifiable Credential.

proof.description: The proof of the european digital credential.

termsOfUse.description: The terms of use of european digital credential.

GoalDescription.description: A statement that describes the desired outcomes.

GoalSuccessCriteria.description: One or more statements that describes the criteria used by teachers and students to check for attainment of a goal.

DateIssued.description: The date when the learning assessment was formally approved/issued.

awardedBy.description: The awarding details of the learning assessment.

AddressApartmentRoomOrSuiteNumber.description: The apartment, room, or suite number of an address.

AddressCity.description: The name of the city in which an address is located.

AddressCountyName.description: The name of the county, parish, borough, or comparable unit (within a state) in which an address is located.

AddressPostalCode.description: A number that identifies each postal delivery area in the United States used as a portion of an address.

AddressStreetNumberAndName.description: The street number and street name or post office box number of an address.

AddressTypeForLearnerOrFamily.description: The type of address listed for a learner or a parent, guardian, family member or related person.

CountryCode.description: The unique two character International Organization for Standardization (ISO) code for the country in which an address is located.

ElectronicMailAddress.description: The numbers, letters, and symbols used to identify an electronic mail (e-mail) user within the network to which the person or organization belongs.

FirstName.description: The full legal first name given to a person at birth, baptism, or through legal change.

GenerationCodeOrSuffix.description: An appendage, if any, used to denote a person's generation in his family (e.g., Jr., Sr., III).

LastOrSurname.description: The full legal last name borne in common by members of a family.

Latitude.description: The north or south angular distance from the equator that, when combined with longitude, reflects an estimation of where the address is physically situated.

Longitude.description: The east or west angular distance from the prime meridian that, when combined with latitude, reflects an estimation of where the address is physically situated.

MiddleName.description: A full legal middle name given to a person at birth, baptism, or through legal change.

PersonIdentificationSystem.description: A coding scheme that is used for identification of a person.

PersonIdentifier.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a person by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity.

PersonalInformationVerification.description: The evidence by which a persons name, address, date of birth, etc. is confirmed.

PersonalTitleOrPrefix.description: An appellation, if any, used to denote rank, placement, or status (e.g., Mr., Ms., Reverend, Sister, Dr., Colonel).

PrimaryTelephoneNumberIndicator.description: An indication that the telephone number should be used as the principal number for a person or organization.

ProofOfResidencyType.description: An accepted form of proof of residency in the district/county/other locality.

StateAbbreviation.description: The abbreviation for the state (within the United States) or outlying area in which an address is located.

TelephoneNumber.description: The telephone number including the area code, and extension, if applicable.

TelephoneNumberType.description: The type of communication number listed for a person.

desiredProficiencyLevel.description: DefinitionText>An optimum or ideal level of proficiency for a competency with respect to an associated position, role, course, or other item. The proficiency level is expressed as a score, a point scale, or a mark among range of values.

proficiencyAcquistionDifficulty.description: A rating or score representing the difficulty of the particular competency to acquire.

requiredProficiencyLevel.description: A minimum level of proficiency for a competency  associated with a position, role, course, or other item.

ClassificationOfInstructionalProgramCode.description: A six-digit code in the form xx.xxxx that identifies instructional program specialties within educational institutions.

ClassificationOfInstructionalProgramUse.description: An indicator of whether the CIP Code is referencing an enrollment program or an award program.

ClassificationOfInstructionalProgramVers.description: The version of CIP being reported.

CreditsRequired.description: The total number of credits required for a student to graduate from the school of enrollment or complete a program.

DistanceEducationProgramEnrollmentIndica.description: An individual's enrollment in a program for which all the required coursework for program completion is able to be completed via distance education courses. Distance education is education that uses one or more technologies to deliver instruction to individuals who are separated from the instructor and to support regular and substantive interaction between the individuals and the instructor synchronously or asynchronously.

NormalLengthOfTimeForCompletion.description: The amount of time necessary for a person to complete all requirements for a degree or certificate according to the institution's catalog. This is typically 4 years (8 semesters or trimesters, or 12 quarters, excluding summer terms) for a bachelor's degree in a standard term-based institution; 2 years (4 semesters or trimesters, or 6 quarters, excluding summer terms) for an associate's degree in a standard term-based institution; and the various scheduled times for certificate programs.

NormalLengthOfTimeForCompletionUnits.description: The unit of measurement for length of time for completion.

PostsecondaryProgramLevel.description: The level describing the concentration of study for a postsecondary program.

ProgramIdentifier.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a program by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity.

ProgramLengthHours.description: The normal length in credit/contact hours of a person's program as published in the institution's catalogue, website, or other official documents.

ProgramLengthHoursType.description: The type of hours (credit or contact) by which the normal length of a program of study is measured.

ProgramName.description: The name of the program of instruction, training, services or benefits available through federal, state, or local agencies.

ProgramSponsorType.description: A type of organization providing funds for a particular educational or service program or activity or for an individual's participation in the program or activity.

Work-basedLearningOpportunityType.description: The type of work-based learning opportunity a student participated in.

ExitReason.description: The documented or assumed reason a student is no longer being served by a special program.

ProgramParticipationExitDate.description: The year, month and day on which the person ceased to participate in a program.

ProgramParticipationParticipationStatus.description: The current status of the student's program participation

ProgramParticipationStartDate.description: The year, month and day on which the person began to participate in a program.

accredits.description: Credential, assessment, organization, or learning opportunity for which this organization provides official authorization or approval based on prescribed standards or criteria.
